selection_rule: First packet in file order with status ready, or planned with every dependency satisfied. Satisfied = impl_complete, live_checkpointed, evidence_only or review_pending. A split packet is satisfied when every id in split_into is satisfied. A gaps_found or changes_required packet is satisfied for the packets listed in its own remediation, and for everyone else only once all of that remediation is satisfied. blocked_external packets are skipped, never waited on. `gate` on a planned packet names what must clear before its artifact can advance, not before work can start. Compute the ready set with: python3 docs/coordination/tools/validate_plan.py --ready
acceptance_note: verified/accepted never appear here. Only ARTIFACT_REGISTRY.json carries them and only the lead sets them.
